messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-555900 fired for service=inference-runtime-prod. symptom=burst of 5xx errors + streaming disconnects on /v1/generate; priority=P1. escalation policy started, paging primary on-call: Nadia R.

Nadia R: Acked. I'm at my desk. seeing duplicate pages? My phone got two PD pages and one slack alert. Can someone post the grafana panel for 5xx and the list of recent kube events?

ops-bot: grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/ai/runtime?panel=errors. kube events: 8 Warning UnhealthyPod inference-worker-3 CrashLoopBackOff; 2 Warning NodePressure node-g DiskPressure; repeated ModelLoadError on pods scheduled to node-g. Note: PagerDuty shows duplicate trigger due to a flapping healthcheck (we've had PD dedupe glitch reported).

Hector M: Acked as backup (jumping in). I'm seeing NVMe write latency spikes on node-g and node-h. shard load storms are coinciding with a large tenant bulk-upload.

Nadia R: taking lead. quick mitigation plan: 1) throttle cache-populate jobs 2) route latency-sensitive tenants to quantized fallback 3) cordon node-g to stop scheduling heavy IO. executing step 1 now.

DeployBot: rdwctl jobs set cache-populate concurrency 1 --scope prod -> accepted.

Hector M: applying cordon: kubectl cordon node-g; taint nodes node-g cache-warm=disabled:NoSchedule -> applied. Will restart crashloop pods 1-by-1 after routing change.

Nadia R: routing change: rdwctl routing set-weight realtime inference-quantized 65 --tenants tenant-equinox,tenant-sable --ttl 45m

CS-Bot: Notifying CS: customers tenant-equinox and tenant-sable experiencing elevated errors.

Priya K (manager): I'm being paged by escalation since incident still unresolved. Acking. Please confirm customer impact and ETA. Also, why did we get duplicate pager pages?

Nadia R: ETA ~30m to stabilize. Duplicate pages likely due to a transient probe mis-evaluation that retriggered PagerDuty; ops team is looking into PD dedupe but not blocking mitigation. Customer impact: elevated 5xx and some streaming disconnects for long-context uploads for two enterprise tenants.

Hector M: starting rolling restart for crashloop pods: kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment inference-worker --max-unavailable=1. Doing one node at a time.

ops-bot: After cordon + throttle + routing, 5xx down ~60% in 6m. p95 latency trending down but still 1.7x baseline. NVMe util on node-h still high (88%).

Nadia R: pushing temporary gateway circuit to reject very-large contexts to avoid retry storms: rdwctl gateway config set circuit max_seq 16384 --action reject --ttl 2h

Hector M: I see a stuck bulk upload job from tenant-sable filling the cache population queue. Kicking the job queue worker to backoff: kubectl -n prod exec job-queue-processor -- env BACKOFF=true && restart.

Priya K: good mitigation. Sam (CS), please send short customer update stating mitigation steps and ETA. Keep wording high level.

CS-Bot: Draft sent to CS: "Update: We're seeing elevated 5xx for some long-context requests since 04:12 UTC. Routing has been adjusted to fallback models, and on-call has reduced cache population concurrency to stabilize NVMe pressure. We expect normalization within ~30 minutes and will share a post-incident summary."

Nadia R: committing a small runtime guard to serialize shard loads per node (hotfix): commit git@repo:inference#a3f9d2b. Will canary after we stabilize.

DeployBot: canary rollout of guard to node-k -> health ok.

ops-bot: PagerDuty note: manager escalation had fired; manager (Priya K) acknowledged at 2400000302. Also found that PD dedupe triggered two page events because healthcheck TTL toggled; filing PD ticket separately.

Hector M: after job backoff and restart, NVMe util dropped to 65% on node-h and node-g. Error rate down to baseline at 04:38 UTC.

Nadia R: verifying impacted tenants list: tenant-equinox, tenant-sable. CS notified. No persistent data loss observed; transient timeouts only.

Priya K: Please include in postmortem: root cause hypothesis (cache-populate/bulk upload + NVMe saturation), why duplicate PD pages happened, and action items: PD dedupe monitoring, automatic fallback routing when NVMe SLO breaches, and on-call DND/backup training. Also assign postmortem owners.

Hector M: opening infra ticket INFRA-2247 to inspect NVMe health on node-g and node-h and schedule replacement if SMART counters continue to degrade.

Nadia R: closing steps: keep fallback routing for 30 minutes, revert circuit after observation window, and run extra validation across tenants. Closing PD incident in PagerDuty now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-555900 marked resolved by Nadia R at 2400000890.

Priya K: postmortem owners: Nadia (incident lead & runtime guard), Hector (infra & NVMe health), CS (customer timeline). Please deliver postmortem by EOD tomorrow. Good recovery and coordination.

Nadia R: noted. I'll file the postmortem and link the CS notes and deploy commit. Closing thread. :thumbsup:
